meta.description: Practice Hindu mantra japa online with Japam: match-3 gameplay, deity audio, 108 counting, and community yagnas.

blocks.text: Online Japa and Digital Mantra Practice

runs.text: platform: play a match-3 game while hearing authentic deity mantras, track your japa count, and join collective Maha Japa Yagnas — in many Indian languages.
Online japa does not replace temple worship or your family's puja rules; it supports daily repetition when you are travelling, at work breaks, or learning a new mantra.

items: Mantra audio tied to gameplay — stay engaged while chanting
Open japam.digital on phone or desktop
Pick your ishta devata from the menu
Play matches; each session adds to your japa count

runs.text: Sign in with Google to save progress, or use guest mode to try japa without an account. Explore Maha Yagnas from the menu for community chanting goals.

faqs.question: Is Japam free?
faqs.answer: You can try guest play and core japa features; some levels and Pro features may require sign-in or support (dakshina) as shown in the app.

faqs.question: Which deities are available?
faqs.answer: Rama, Shiva, Ganesh, Lakshmi, Hanuman, Venkateswara, Murugan, Navagraha deities, and more — see the in-app deity grid.

faqs.question: Do I need headphones?
faqs.answer: Recommended for mantra audio clarity; respect quiet spaces and others around you.

faqs.question: Can I use Japam offline?
faqs.answer: The PWA can cache some assets after you visit; full features need connectivity for sign-in and leaderboards.

faqs.question: Is this an ISKCON-only app?
faqs.answer: No — Japam includes many sampradayas' deities, including ISKCON (Hare Krishna) as one option among many.

disclaimer.text: This article is for educational and devotional practice only. Japam does not provide medical, legal, or financial advice.
